contract.title: Authoritative Service Impact Profile & Business-Impact Classification Readiness
acceptance_criteria: Execution changes only the exact twenty-two allowed paths and Exact Scope Guard reports COMPLIANT; no implicit or wildcard scope expansion is permitted.

BusinessImpact retains the approved meaning of expected organizational consequence if the specific finding is successfully exploited under the supported evidence-backed technical scenario, while TASK-0130 performs no Business Impact classification or calculation.

BusinessImportance is a new immutable enterprise-context enum with exactly CRITICAL HIGH MEDIUM and LOW because no existing active type has CIA business-importance semantics; other criticality severity and priority enums are rejected even when labels match.

The immutable ServiceImpactProfile contains exactly canonical_asset_id business_service confidentiality_importance integrity_importance availability_importance and source_reference; all strings are non-empty canonical values and all CIA values are actual BusinessImportance members.

The strict JSON authority accepts only root serviceImpactProfiles and exact record keys canonicalAssetId businessService confidentialityImportance integrityImportance availabilityImportance and sourceReference; malformed unknown missing empty normalized or invalid values fail controlled.

An unconfigured SERVICE_IMPACT_PROFILE_PATH and a missing canonical record remain truthfully unavailable; configured unreadable or malformed authority fails controlled and duplicate equal or conflicting canonical-asset records fail closed without selection or merge.
Finding profile resolution consumes the authoritative TASK-0129 business-context snapshot and returns exactly RESOLVED NOT_FOUND or MISSING_CANONICAL_ASSET plus controlled integrity failure.

A RESOLVED profile exactly matches canonical_asset_id and business_service from the authoritative business-context snapshot; identifier or service mismatch fails closed and resolution never relies on mutable service name alone.

The normalized technical-effect projection supports only applicable available NVD CVSS v3.0 or v3.1 vectors and parses exact C I and A metrics N L or H into a distinct TechnicalEffectLevel NONE LOW or HIGH without using the CVSS score as authority.

Technical-effect output retains finding and CVE identity vector source provenance and observed_at; unsupported CVSS versions malformed or missing metrics inapplicable TI and unavailable sources produce explicit unavailable or not-evaluated results.
Multiple CVEs remain separate provenance-bearing technical effects and are not aggregated into a synthetic finding-wide effect or Business Impact.

BusinessImpactClassificationReadiness returns only READY or UNAVAILABLE and preserves finding identity business facts profile facts technical effects exact missing requirements source references completeness and result provenance with immutable state invariants.

READY requires authoritative TASK-0129 Business Context an exact matching Service Impact Profile all three CIA BusinessImportance facts provenance an applicable supported technical-effect projection mutually consistent snapshots AVAILABLE completeness deterministic result provenance and empty missing requirements.

Any missing unsupported malformed stale conflicting or inconsistent prerequisite yields UNAVAILABLE with exact requirements and valid partial facts and provenance retained where safe; UNKNOWN and NOT_EVALUATED are never collapsed into LOW.

FindingRiskContext integrates service_impact_profile technical_effect and business_impact_classification_readiness into the existing projection while preserving TASK-0127 TASK-0128 and TASK-0129 snapshot identity and semantics.

FindingRiskContext business_impact remains null decision remains null and recommendations remain empty in every result; no impact score band matrix narrative consequence owner crown-jewel or management conclusion is introduced.
The API serializes typed profile facts technical effects status reasons missing requirements completeness observed_at and provenance without losing identity or allowing contradictory READY snapshots.

The frontend parser rejects invalid enums duplicate conflicting mismatched provenance or inconsistent transported snapshots and the existing Finding Risk Context section renders only authoritative profile and technical-effect facts or explicit unavailable states labelled as readiness rather than impact.

Without a Product-Owner-authorized profile record the real DistCC projection reports Service Impact Profile NOT_FOUND Business-Impact Classification Readiness UNAVAILABLE and business_impact null with no CIA importance or impact inferred.
No AssetCriticality ServiceCriticality FindingRiskPriority vendor severity CVSS score EPSS KEV TI exposure or label equivalence can establish BusinessImportance or Business Impact.

No frozen AssetContext AssetBusinessContext RiskReadiness PriorityEngine legacy BusinessContextEngine BusinessImpactBuilder Decision Recommendation AI/provider mock Risk Manager Executive or runtime authority is modified invoked or populated.

Focused domain source resolution technical-effect readiness integration API parser and rendering tests cover immutability strict schemas duplicates conflicts snapshot mismatches enum substitution unsupported vectors provenance loss contradictory states and negative non-invocation guarantees.
Full Python and frontend regressions TypeScript production build git diff --check and Exact Scope Guard pass while TASK-0127 TASK-0128 TASK-0129 and platform behavior remain intact.

Product Owner live acceptance verifies truthful unavailable behavior for DistCC and any separately authorized controlled profile scenario; execution may not mark acceptance PASS create TASK-0131 or transition TASK-0130 to DONE.
